stage0017_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ha ha ha, $$錦織つばさ$$!
　Tremble in fear!
　You'll pay for Dr. Hell's grudge with your life!」

stage0017_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Such tasteless men.
　$$静子$$ came all this way to visit Atami,
　and this is what greets her」

stage0017_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$クロス$$
「Ma'am, get your friend to safety, just in case?」

stage0017_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$静子$$
「No need to worry, Mr. $$クロス$$.
　It seems everything's fine」

stage0017_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$安$$
「That's right!
　Looks like your proud son's here!」

stage0017_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Stop this attack, now!」

stage0017_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$ゴッドマーズ$$!
　So $$明神タケル$$ has come!」

stage0017_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I have a grudge against you too!
　I'll wrap you in flame along with Atami!」

stage0017_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アキラ$$
「Even with his master Dr. Hell defeated,
　he's still at it, geez!」

stage0017_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Guess we'll go easy on him, then」

stage0017_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミカ$$
「$$ナオト$$, $$アキラ$$!
　Take this seriously!」

stage0017_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$ミカ$$'s right.
　If you're not feeling it, I'll send you back
　to observing the black hole」

stage0017_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Fighting villains suits us better, after all」

stage0017_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Then get serious.
　I'll cover Mars」

stage0017_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アキラ$$
「Tch... $$ロゼ$$'s basically become
　the Crusher Team's vice-captain...」

stage0017_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Mars!
　That statue's moving on the flying fortress's orders!」

stage0017_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$タケル$$
「Got it, $$ロゼ$$!
　I'll take down the Ghoul, for Atami's sake too!」

stage0017_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$タケル$$!」

stage0017_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「With this much firepower gathered,
　there's nothing to fear」

stage0017_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$葵$$
「Huh... so $$ロゼ$$'s with the Crusher Team too」

stage0017_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So you came to Earth
　chasing after your beloved $$タケル$$, huh」

stage0017_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「$$朔哉$$, you sound a bit jealous」

stage0017_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Whose fault do you think that is!」

stage0017_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's leave it there.
　Protecting Atami comes first」

stage0017_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$'s right.
　Look, even $$オックス$$ is exasperated」

stage0017_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Am I... Team D's comic relief, or something...」

stage0017_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's great, isn't it, $$朔哉$$.
　Now you've got a role besides the Boost Nova Knuckle」

stage0017_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$n
「Still, it's a surprise that $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$
　became a mobile fortress...」

stage0017_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n is fighting for revenge...
　Then, just who are they trying to fight...）

stage0017_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「S-sorry...!
　Seems I got lost admiring $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ too!」

stage0017_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I've been waiting, $$兜甲児$$ and friends!
　Right before your eyes, this Atami...」

stage0017_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, $$ブロッケン$$!
　I'm not listening to your same old grudge speech!」

stage0017_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuoh!
　To ignore my words like that...!」

stage0017_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$甲児$$
「Get ready!
　You dragged innocent people into this fight,
　so I'll crush you thoroughly, right here!」

stage0017_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh, everyone's fired up.
　Then, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$... your attack orders, please」

stage0017_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Everyone, the time to fight has come.
　With your strength, sweep away the evil fog
　trying to cover this world」

stage0017_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$柿小路$$
「As expected of Fog Sweeper, that's $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ for you...
　You really deliver」

stage0017_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$タケル$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　Our target is $$ブロッケン伯爵$$'s Ghoul!」

stage0017_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm doing this!
　I'll protect the Atami
　that Grandpa loved!」

stage0017_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nguh!
　Those brats, have they grown even stronger!」

stage0017_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「But...!
　If I retreat here, my pride as $$ブロッケン$$...!」

stage0017_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「I said retreat, $$ブロッケン$$」

stage0017_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Soon, that place will become the stage
　for a fresh battle. If you want to be dragged in
　and fall to hell again, then stay right there」

stage0017_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「A-alright.
　I'll follow your orders」

stage0017_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Tch...!
　Is the situation against us...!」

stage0017_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「What are you saying, $$あしゅら$$!
　I haven't lost yet!」

stage0017_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「I said retreat, $$ブロッケン$$」

stage0017_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Soon, that place will become the stage
　for a fresh battle. If you want to be dragged in
　and fall to hell again, then stay right there」

stage0017_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「A-alright.
　I'll follow your orders」

stage0017_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$さやか$$
「That was a surprisingly easy retreat」

stage0017_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ボス$$
「That headless Count Me-Out
　probably got scared of our strength」

stage0017_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ナオト$$
「He means $$ブロッケン伯爵$$」

stage0017_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アキラ$$
「He's a count who wants out.
　'Count me out!' Get it?」

stage0017_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「...Sorry.
　I don't understand Earth jokes」

stage0017_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ボス$$
「W-what!
　Is it really that big a deal!」

stage0017_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$タケル$$
「It's fine, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$.
　$$ボス$$ was just trying to lighten the mood」

stage0017_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「As expected, $$タケル$$!
　You're a real class act!」

stage0017_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Heh heh... $$静子$$.
　$$タケル$$'s still the same as ever」

stage0017_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$静子$$
「Yes...
　It's been a while since I came back to Earth,
　but it's good to see you doing well」

stage0017_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「All right, everyone, let's check the city's damage,
　then help put out fires and clear debris」

stage0017_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Be careful!
　This reading... it's just like back then...!」

stage0017_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Those mysterious aliens from before...!
　This time there's even a huge UFO!」

stage0017_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$タケル$$
「So even 《$$ズール$$》's minions are here!」

stage0017_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
Psychic
「That's right, Mars.
　It's been a while since we last met face to face」

stage0017_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「So the mysterious aliens serve the revived $$ズール$$?!」

stage0017_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
Psychic
「We are now loyal servants of the Demon King...」

stage0017_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
Psychic
「The darkness of space that swallows all...
　That is our Demon King...」

stage0017_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「You Gishin, I have another mission.
　Leave the one who bears the sun, and Mars, to you」

stage0017_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I wish you good luck in battle」

stage0017_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Huh? The command ship is retreating!」

stage0017_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「At this rate, the truth behind this so-called
　Demon King, we may have to ask them directly」

stage0017_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
Psychic
「Do you think mere you could do that?」

stage0017_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
Psychic
「Now, here we come!
　Show us the full extent of your power!」

stage0017_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Silence!
　No matter what you may be, invaders targeting Earth
　will never be forgiven!」

stage0017_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's right!
　We'll beat you and make you name the Demon King!」

stage0017_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
Psychic
「Fools!
　You'll all be engulfed by the Demon King's darkness!」

stage0017_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$セイミー$$, what about the psychic that got away?」

stage0017_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$セイミー$$
「No luck.
　Small fry or not, they really are a psychic.
　Looks like even the Kurogane Five lost them」

stage0017_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't worry, $$正太郎$$.
　No matter what comes, we will never lose」

stage0017_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$タケル$$
「Whether our enemy is a Demon King or a devil,
　we'll protect Earth with our own hands」

stage0017_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$タケル$$
「My psychic powers have gotten stronger too!
　I'll show $$ゴッドマーズ$$' full power from the very start!」

stage0017_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「You're all fired up, Mars.
　Is it because this is your second home?」

stage0017_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's part of it.
　But I made a vow to protect everything in this
　universe from evil's grasp」

stage0017_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「That's the spirit.
　We'll back $$タケル$$ up with everything we've got too」

stage0017_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「I share that resolve too, Mars.
　That's why I came to Earth, after all」

stage0017_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$タケル$$
（And, 《$$マーグ#pilot$$》...
　For the vow I made to you, I'll wager this life
　and fight for peace!）

stage0017_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Dr. Hell is already gone!
　Give up and surrender!」

stage0017_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You infuriating man!
　If only you hadn't come, I could've at least
　burned $$くろがね屋$$ to ashes!」

stage0017_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$タケル$$
「My mother is at $$くろがね屋$$ too!
　I won't let you do any such thing!」

stage0017_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$甲児$$
「You never learn, do you, $$ブロッケン$$!
　Bold of you, with no Mechanical Beasts on hand!」

stage0017_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「S-silence!
　We are currently building up our forces!」

stage0017_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$甲児$$
「We...?
　So, that guy really is behind you after all...」

stage0017_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You need not know the answer to that!
　You will fall to hell here, by my own hand!」

stage0017_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$竜馬$$
「It's been a while, $$ブロッケン$$!
　$$甲児$$ told me all about it, you sure caused quite
　a scene at Jindai High!」

stage0017_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「What are you so riled up about!?
　What business is that place of yours!?」

stage0017_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I became that school's janitor, like a big brother!
　I'll deal with any thugs who sneak into the school!」

stage0017_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「D-digging up such an old story...!」

stage0017_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut up!
　That's rich, coming from Dr. Hell's own avenger!」

stage0017_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You mysterious aliens!
　Are you seriously invading Earth now!?」

stage0017_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$!
　Whether it's a Demon King or whatever else,
　we'll show them we never give up!」

stage0017_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$タケル$$
「I sense a strong presence behind these guys...!
　It's different from $$ズール$$, but I feel the same kind
　of dark, terrifying power!」

stage0017_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$タケル$$
「You mean someone like that is targeting Earth now...!」

stage0017_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Be it a Demon King or a devil,
　if you're after Earth, we'll be your opponents!」

stage0017_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$甲児$$
「The power of Mazinger's light
　will strip away your bluffing!」

stage0017_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「When dealing with shady types like these,
　words aren't needed!」

stage0017_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Just crush them, plain and simple!」

stage0017_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Just when I thought we'd finally dealt with the
　terrorists, now aliens are coming to attack too!?」

stage0017_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You jerk!
　If I stop growing taller because of stress,
　it'll be all your fault!」

stage0017_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$葵$$
「Darkness, Demon Kings, all that occult stuff,
　I'm already sick of it...!」

stage0017_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$葵$$
「So that's how it is,
　sorry, but I've got no interest in your nonsense!」

stage0017_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$n
「You invaders...!
　We're making you leave Earth!」

stage0017_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n's motive for fighting...
　In the end, it's about protecting someone's life...）

stage0017_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$スズネ$$
（If that's so, then who on earth could it be
　that $n is seeking revenge against...）
